question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Esteem
solution: The correct answer is **"Respect."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Esteem"** means respect or admiration for someone. (सम्‍मान; किसी के प्रति आदरभाव) • **Example**: *She was held in high **esteem**__ by her colleagues for her hard work and dedication.* • Synonyms of **Esteem** include **respect, admiration, honor, and regard**. • **"Respect"** means the feeling that you have when you admire or have a high opinion of somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति आदर-भावना) __ • **Example**: *I have little **respect**__ for people who are arrogant.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Excuse**, means to provide a reason or justification for something. (छोटी-मोटी ग़लती माफ़ करना) • **Option 2, Abuse**, means to use something in a harmful or improper way, or to mistreat someone. (किसी वस्‍तु को बुरे या ग़लत ढंग से प्रयुक्त करना) • **Option 3, Ridicule**, means to mock or make fun of someone in a cruel or insulting way. (खिल्‍ली उड़ाना, मज़ाक़ बनाना) 30:T631, The correct answer is **"Quit addictive or dangerous behaviour."**
